title: Stop Saying "Very" in English: 30 Words to Use Instead of "Very" (With Pictures)
description:
Stop saying "very" in English: 30 words to use instead of very big, very good, very happy, very tired, very bad and very small. Every word comes with a picture, a clear meaning and an example sentence. After each set of five words, you test yourself with a quick quiz and practise speaking by repeating the example sentences out loud after me.

The 30 words
Very big: huge, giant, enormous, massive, vast
Very good: excellent, superb, fantastic, outstanding, brilliant
Very happy: thrilled, delighted, overjoyed, ecstatic, elated
Very tired: exhausted, drained, worn out, shattered, weary
Very bad: terrible, awful, dreadful, horrible, atrocious
Very small: tiny, minuscule, microscopic, miniature, compact

Which word was new to you? Write it in the comments.
